Biallelic NF2 inactivation (germline plus somatic, or two somatic hits) is the central driver of sporadic schwannoma and NF2-related schwannomatosis.

Germline SMARCB1 variants cause SMARCB1-related schwannomatosis with multiple non-intradermal schwannomas; SMARCB1/INI1 loss characterizes epithelioid schwannoma. SMARCB1-related disease carries elevated malignancy and meningioma risk.
Germline LZTR1 variants cause LZTR1-related schwannomatosis with multiple non-intradermal schwannomas, including a risk of unilateral vestibular schwannoma.
